item.cosmicbreach.drift_gel.tooltip: A cool, faintly lit gel. Eaten raw it feeds a little and gives night vision for 30 seconds.
item.cosmicbreach.drift_gel.tooltip.use: Cook it on a campfire, in a furnace or in a smoker for candied gel.
item.cosmicbreach.candied_gel.tooltip: Sweet, firm gel. A filling snack with none of the glow.
